But that contradicts... Actually corrections replace old content. The old fact was about team composition. New: "As of 2025-07-02, Team Atlas consists of Priya; Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune." Hmm, I think safest: "As of 2025-07-02, Tomasz Nowak is no longer on Team Atlas; Team Atlas continues without them." Let me phrase: "As of 2025-07-02, Team Atlas consists of Priya alone after Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune." Hmm, "alone" is inference but reasonable given "continues without them" and prior fact of two members. Actually the combination: Team Atlas consisted of Priya and Tomasz; Tomasz transferred; Atlas continues without them → Team Atlas consists of Priya. That's a valid inference.
